sourceResponseTiming.requestStartedUtc: Exact preserved areas[].retrievedUtc recorded by fetch_area before the HTTP request; it is a request-start observation, not completion time.
sourceResponseTiming.elapsedSeconds: Exact preserved helper elapsedSeconds, rounded to two decimals; it includes the request, subprocess and local response parsing/inspection. No exact HTTP completion timestamp was retained.
sourceResponseTiming.otherTimestamps: Object timestamp is the OSM editing date and preparedUtc is source selection time. metadata.lastUpdated remains the scheduled-sync historical cursor; this source-response evidence does not rewrite it.
